sources.snippet: eLLM is an LLM inference framework for CPU servers. It adopts a "trade storage for computation" strategy, leveraging the CPU's large-capacity DDR memory to close the order-of-magnitude bandwidth gap against GPU HBM, and thereby delivers performance that surpasses GPUs in long-horizon inference.
